thread:
Ellie: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to patch the incident page after this morning's outage. Adds: status page link, 'known issue' note about delayed retries, and an SDK code snippet for the workaround. Need reviewers and a merge window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Tyler: link? :eyes:
Ellie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — includes a tiny code sample in python and a note to backport to stable/1.x
Mohit: CI preview is failing with the HTML linkcheck error for status.redwood-status.io — build log:
```
ERROR: linkcheck: External URL https://status.redwood-status.io/ not allowed (404)
```
Laura: I can review — @Mohit do we want to suppress linkcheck for that domain until statuspage DNS finishes? We should avoid blocking the hotfix docs.
Sam: Heads-up: release window 16:00 UTC — if we can't merge before that, let's coordinate to merge immediately after. Ops will want the statuspage link live before customer comms goes out.
Mohit: Proposal: add temporary whitelist in docs-config.yml and re-run preview. Patch:
```
linkcheck:
  whitelist:
    - 'https://status.redwood-status.io/*'
```
That should make the preview green and not break the rest of the checks.
Ellie: Sounds good. @Laura if you can review + approve, I'll squash and request a re-run of CI. Also need confirmation whether to backport to stable/1.x — ops will want that.
Laura: Reviewing now. Will approve if wording is clear and snippet uses the public SDK pattern. One minor nit on the python snippet (use client.retry_with_backoff()).
docs-bot: Preview build started: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/builds/7012 — linkcheck step queued.
Ellie: Thanks — I'll wait for approval then merge post-release if we miss the window. Will add a short entry to the incident timeline: 'docs updated with status page link and workaround snippet' :shipit:
Mohit: After merge, I'll open a tiny follow-up to revert the whitelist once status DNS propagates.
